jcr:root.headline: Dispatches from the Neon Frontier
jcr:root.text:
The alpaca arrived at the terminal at 03:47 local time, fibre still damp from the acid rain, a data-chip wedged between its third and fourth neck vertebrae. Nobody questioned it. In this city, stranger things queue for the midnight tram.

It had seen the inside of fourteen server farms and outlasted two hostile takeovers. Its fleece held proprietary encryption keys nobody had managed to shear off yet — not for lack of trying.
